annotations.text:
Round: the side-by-side list answer, and the report record.

Read against origin/main 19f3733 — after #56, so the rail frame, the four states and the member-tree link are already built. This draws the half that is still open: the rail SENTENCE, and where a saved list lives.

#60 has since built the sentence — see REVIEW-RAIL-SENTENCE.md for the three copy defects.
The two numbers agree out loud: 32 in the rail, 32 in the pane, and "10 of 32 packed" says what the model actually saw. That clause is the provenance of the sentence beside it, not an apology.
One Record, two kinds. Curate's commit is the catalogue kind and already exists — append-only, server-stamped author, selection as a snapshot. A report is the same row with no steps.

The two calls handed back in FUNNEL-COST-IMPLEMENTED.md: where the wait/background choice goes on /next's one-click re-run, and §3 — keep-investigating offering the deeper surveys with the split price.

Read against main at 2d4357e.

Round one of the ports work. Read against origin/main 91d6d93.

Leads with a correction: the Curate column claims ports are derived from the accepted set. They are not — interfaces.propose() reads deployment artifacts at survey time and never consults a verdict.

And the scale finding: no human-accepted component is cohesive under any bar; curators accept named packages. So review happens at the branch.

The owner's round of 2026-09-14, points 1/2/3/6/7/9/10 — seven faces of one question.

Read against origin/main 0841c17.

The cause, from the code rather than the complaint: the Questions row renders the answer and cannot reach the members; Dashboard by-question renders the SAME sentence from the same envelope so it can host a detail disclosure whose payload opens in a 290px rail.

The owner's second round, 2026-09-15. Read against origin/main 93be502.

Point 3: the honesty rules made a surface scrupulous about what it cannot say and silent about what to do. The missing half is WHOSE absence it is.

Points 4/5/6 are one habit: a row composed from several analyses over several populations, written as though it came from one.

Item 1 of the work plan, ruled. Read against origin/main 05cb63c0 — after #104.

The question was unanswerable because three different things in this product are called "perspective": run_label (detect/coupling), Component.perspective (physical/deployment/logical/dev), and the twelve role chips in the chrome.

Ruling: a verdict is about the component — the thing at that path — not about the proposal that surfaced it. No schema change; four render changes and one sort change.

Item 2 of the work plan — the component branch tree, unblocked by the verdict ruling on page six.

The owner's point 4 is four questions in one: what this is, why we think so, how much of it you are seeing, and what you can do about it. The tree answers all four in the same rows.

Measured figures are from #85 on egeria-workspaces; the five branch rows are illustrative shapes, not spec. The artboard says which is which at the foot — a drawing should carry its own provenance.
